checkin.title: Daily check-in
checkin.subtitle: There are no right answers. Share what feels true today.
checkin.requestSupport: I'd like to speak with a welfare officer
checkin.consentRequired: Enable wellness sharing in Privacy & access before submitting.
checkin.sharedWith: Shared with your welfare officer only. Never shared with commanders or HR.
checkin.editPolicy: You may edit today's check-in up to 11:59 PM. Earlier check-ins cannot be edited.

priority.disclaimer: This is a welfare indicator, not a clinical assessment.

consent.title: Your data and consent
consent.wellnessDesc: Share mood, sleep and fatigue data for welfare review.
consent.wearableDesc: Link an approved wearable device. Not currently enabled.
consent.aiProcessingDesc: Allow anonymised factor data to be sent to an AI provider for plain-language summaries.
consent.withdrawWarning: Withdrawing wellness consent will remove your stored check-ins and wellness values from future assessments. Duty records and audit events are retained.

support.title: Request confidential support
support.description: Your request will appear in your welfare officer's queue. You do not need to share a reason.
support.submitted: Your support request has been submitted.
support.urgentNote: If you are in immediate danger, contact your emergency services (dial 112) or speak to a trusted colleague directly. This system does not dispatch emergency responders.
support.noScore: You do not need a particular indicator score to request support.

commander.suppressed: Group too small to display (fewer than {min} personnel).
commander.scenarioDisclaimer: Estimates only. Based on current duty records and stated rules. Does not predict mental-health outcomes or model staffing coverage. No real schedules are changed.
